title: Live PM planned 3-agent 2-task verification
specification:
Create a live autonomy verification run driven by PM planning.

The PM plan must produce exactly 6 implementation tasks total and no reviewer tasks.

Task shape requirements:
- Exactly 2 tasks for aquarium-agent.
- Exactly 2 tasks for adventure-agent.
- Exactly 2 tasks for action-agent.
- Each task must be lane-scoped and atomic.
- Each task should create or update exactly one markdown note file for that lane.
- The two tasks in each lane must land on the same branch so the resulting PR has 2 commits, one commit per task.

Required file targets:
- aquarium-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-aq-1.md
- aquarium-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-aq-2.md
- adventure-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-adv-1.md
- adventure-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-adv-2.md
- action-agent task 1 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-act-1.md
- action-agent task 2 should target src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260314-200407-press6-act-2.md

Each task acceptance criteria must mention the exact file path it owns.
Use stable task ids derived from prd-live-20260314-200407-press6.
Use sprintId multi-agent-mvp.
